prediction.reason: The 25 MC per-semester cap makes 160 MC unreachable in 6 semesters. Almost every module is 4 or 8 MC, so a semester reaches 25 MC only with one of the two 5 MC modules (CS3216, CS3217), giving at most 4×24 + 2×25 = 146 MC of coursework; adding the largest off-load internship credit allowed (12 MC, e.g. CP3200 + CP3202) still gives at most 158 MC, short of the 160 MC graduation requirement.
